PUBLIC means your game will be visible by any player. PRIVATE means your game is only accessible by your friends and invited players.

This setting allows you to modify the combat rules.

CONQUEST mode favors territory control. Each Command Zone provides Conquest Points per second. The first side to reach the Conquest Point objective wins the game.

DESTRUCTION mode favors the destruction of units. Destroying enemy units earns Destruction Points according to their cost. The first side to reach its Destruction Point objective wins the game.

This setting allows you to limit the amount of units to be fielded simultaneously.
The higher the value you set, the more the income will be restricted with each new unit called in, thus intensifying the tactical aspect of the game.
The smaller the value, the less the income will be impacted. At 0%, reinforcement have no impact on income at all.
This prevents winning players from accumulating forces too quickly.

In the Mod Center you can enable, remove, modify, and browse game modifications created by the community.
Play online. You will also find a Friends List, a Server browser, the option to Create or Join games, Ranked matches, and Leaderboards.
The Options menus allow you to configure the game's settings in great detail. You can change and modify Gameplay, Interface, Controls, Video, and Audio settings.
In the Player Profile menu you can change your in-game nickname. You can check your detailed game statistics across all game modes.

Play offline. In the Solo menu you can access all the single-player modes. This includes the Tutorials, scripted Operations, strategic Army General campaigns, and tactical Skirmish mode. In Load, you can find all your Saved games, including Replays of past battles.
